title: LSM12 facilitates the progression of colorectal cancer by activating the WNT/CTNNB1 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhuang, Yan; Ning, Chunlan; Liu, Pengfei; Zhao, Yanpeng; Li, Yue; Ma, Zhenchi; Shan, Luling; Piao, Yingzhe; Zhao, Peng; Jin, Xun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LSM12通过结合CTNNB1激活WNT通路促进结直肠癌进展，虽涉及蛋白-DNA转录复合物，但核心为癌症机制且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅少量蛋白互作模拟，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Aberrant activation of the WNT signaling pathway is a joint event in colorectal cancer (CRC), but the molecular mechanism is still unclear. Recently, RNA-splicing factor LSM12 (like-Sm protein 12) is highly expressed in CRC tissues. This study aimed to verify whether LSM12 is involved in regulating CRC progression via regulating the WNT signaling pathway. Here, we found that LSM12 is highly expressed in CRC patient-derived tissues and cells. LSM12 is involved in the proliferation, invasion, and apoptosis of CRC cells, similar to the function of WNT signaling in CRC. Furthermore, protein interaction simulation and biochemical experiments proved that LSM12 directly binds to CTNNB1 (also known as beta-Catenin) and regulates its protein stability to affect the CTTNB1-LEF1-TCF1 transcriptional complex formation and the associated WNT downstream signaling pathway. LSM12 depletion in CRC cells decreased the in vivo tumor growth through repression of cancer cell growth and acceleration of cancer cell apoptosis. Taken together, we suggest that the high expression of LSM12 is a novel factor leading to aberrant WNT signaling activation, and that strategies targeting this molecular mechanism may contribute to developing a new therapeutic method for CRC.
abstract_zh: WNT信号通路的异常激活是结直肠癌（CRC）中的常见事件，但其分子机制仍不清楚。近期，RNA剪接因子LSM12（like-Sm protein 12）在CRC组织中高表达。本研究旨在验证LSM12是否通过调控WNT信号通路参与调节CRC进展。在此，我们发现LSM12在CRC患者来源的组织和细胞中高表达。LSM12参与CRC细胞的增殖、侵袭和凋亡，其功能与WNT信号在CRC中的作用相似。此外，蛋白质相互作用模拟和生化实验证明，LSM12直接结合CTNNB1（也称为beta-Catenin），并调节其蛋白质稳定性，从而影响CTTNB1-LEF1-TCF1转录复合物的形成及相关的WNT下游信号通路。在CRC细胞中敲低LSM12，通过抑制癌细胞生长和加速癌细胞凋亡，降低了体内肿瘤生长。综上所述，我们认为LSM12的高表达是导致WNT信号异常激活的新因素，针对这一分子机制的策略可能有助于开发CRC的新治疗方法。
